rows.observation: fay-willows.lua:537-555 多处语义/关系错误：①“the treatment of the ogres”指邪教徒如何对待食人魔（上下文问为何不杀他们），误译为“对食人魔进行治疗”；②漏译“I see little reason for you or any shalore to care.”整句；③“Standing above the young shalore as she slowly caught her breathe, I could see him fold his arms.”是将军站在喘息未定的年轻永恒精灵（女巫）旁边并抱臂，译文“我看到女巫站在年轻的永恒精灵前方，她慢慢地屏住呼吸，双臂合拢”主体和动作全错（caught her breath≠屏住呼吸）；④“what transpired after you had left for the Nargol Kingdom to the point when you came back”指从动身前往纳格尔王国到返回为止，译为“离开纳格尔王国回到埃尔瓦拉的路途中”范围错误；⑤“走进向巫”为错字（应为走近女巫）；⑥“kill them then and there”=当场杀死，译为“在各处屠杀”；⑦“Finished”指施法完毕，误译“说完”。
rows.conclusion: 公开 Cults data/lore/fay-willows.lua 同条另见：漏译 I see little reason for you or any shalore to care；what transpired after you had left for the Nargol Kingdom to the point when you came back 为动身前往至返回期间，现译范围错；kill them then and there 为当场杀死，现译“在各处屠杀”；Finished 指施法完毕，现译“说完”；“走进向巫”错字。宿主已核对 then and there 原文。与 surface 两处一并整条修复。本批文件 SHA 匹配，来源仓库/commit 未固定。

rows.observation: world-artifacts.lua:601 原文“creating rifts”为复数且未给数量，译文“创造一个时空裂隙”凭空限定为一个，属机制数量增译；另“等级4的实境撕裂）”后缺句号与下一句粘连。
rows.conclusion: 同条 creating rifts 为复数，实现 data/talents/demented/rift.lua Reality Fracture getNb=3（一次生成多道裂隙）；现译“创造一个时空裂隙”凭空限定为一个，机制数量不符。修复为“在身边创造时空裂隙来帮助你（免费释放一次等级4的实境撕裂）。”并补全末句“要小心。”，标记不动。本批文件 SHA 匹配，来源仓库/commit 未固定。

rows.observation: fay-willows.lua:363-381 多处错误：①叙述者是自然精灵，“I don't believe even among the Thaloren we know much of them”应为“即使在我们自然精灵之中”，误作“永恒精灵之中”（与同句前文 Shaloren 档案混淆，且与本条及 90024a3d 中 Thaloren=自然精灵 不一致）；②“uninviting landscape”=荒凉/令人却步的地貌，误译“不引人注意的风景”；③“a look of shock and irritation more than anything else”指食人魔的神情主要是震惊和恼怒，误译为“眼神看起来比任何其他东西都更令人震惊和恼怒”；④“Pointing out the western direction … with my other arm”主语是“我”（另一只胳膊被食人魔抓着），误作“他们用另一只胳膊指出”；⑤“I shouldn't have expected any less from those … fanatics”意为这正是那帮狂热者会干的事，误译为“不该对他们抱有任何期望”；⑥“一打群人”错字（a group of people）；⑦“What is it?”应为“怎么了”，误作“这是什么？”。
rows.conclusion: 公开 Cults data/lore/fay-willows.lua 同条另见：uninviting landscape 为荒凉的地貌，现译“不引人注意的风景”；a look of shock and irritation more than anything else 的主体是食人魔的神情；I shouldn't have expected any less from those fanatics 意为这正是狂热者会干的事；What is it? 为“怎么了”；“一打群人”错字。与 surface 两处一并整条修复。本批文件 SHA 匹配，来源仓库/commit 未固定。

rows.observation: fay-willows.lua:684-700 多处错误：①“would tell me long after the battle with the undead”意为战后很久才告诉我，误译为“与不死生物战斗很久的指挥官”；②“it means nothing should its soldiers lose the will to fight”意为士兵失去斗志则战力毫无意义，误译为“这意味着士兵们不应失去战斗的意志”；③“in a rather surprisingly loud voice for a shalore he yelled”意为就永恒精灵而言嗓门出奇地大，误译为“对永恒精灵喊道”（喊话对象实为 DEFENDERS）；④“Before its attack could connect … sending its skull sailing away”误译为“在它的攻击还没来得及集中我面前…把它的头骨划开了”，语句残缺且头骨是被打飞；⑤“skeleton archers and mages of the undead force”误作“有着不死之力的法师们”；⑥“Put on my back foot”（陷入被动）误作“在我的后面”。
rows.conclusion: 公开 Cults data/lore/fay-willows.lua 同条另见：would tell me long after the battle with the undead 为战后很久才告诉我；it means nothing should its soldiers lose the will to fight 为士兵失去斗志则战力无意义；sending its skull sailing away 为头骨被打飞；skeleton archers and mages of the undead force；put on my back foot 为陷入被动。与 surface 一处一并整条修复。本批文件 SHA 匹配，来源仓库/commit 未固定。

notes: Cults-only batch: surface ran as four lanes of 20 with no observation slid and no write or terminal patterns. lane-000-0 mis-echoed one identity (result[17], verdict OK: the first 16 hex of the frozen key followed by another entry's tail); the host precheck caught it before harvest, confirmed from the agent's native Codex log that the agent itself wrote it, and harvested a corrected raw that replaces only that string (original and corrected bytes with SHA-256 are recorded in HOST-SURFACE-BOUNDARY-AUDIT.json).
The contextual run read only its own envelope and the contract (no checkout probing), so no refreeze was needed.

Two observations are refuted by the implementation or library names: the crumbling-object log fires while reading a Forbidden Tome, so 这本书 is right, and 'disfigured face power' is this talent tree (该系技能). Regenerative infusions keep the library's 纹身. Overgrowth is confirmed from can_pass pass_wall and Reality Fracture from getNb=3.
Cults public source file SHA matched this batch workset; source repository and commit remain unpinned.
7 confirmed repair revisions raise the window 34 backlog from 11 to 18; below the 20 threshold, so no window opens.
